_about: The moments the stacking lint checks (render/anim/tools/stacking_lint.gd; Legal's rule, docs/design/rule-of-cool.md section 1 rule 9: no single moment may show more than two of the seven marks). Each moment lists the poses it plays and the marks the OTHER systems show during it (VFX, Audio, World, Camera, Art declare theirs here, with their source): 1 a crouch with fists clenched at the sides (found from the poses), 2 a scream or drawn-out chant, 3 a flame-shaped body aura streaming upward, 4 rubble rising in a ring, the ground cracking and wind under a changing sky, 5 crackling lightning on the body, 6 hair rising or changing colour, 7 a gold, white or red flash with a form name shouted. A moment at two marks is a warning (no room left); over two fails. Directors add a moment when they add a set piece; a moment whose owners have not declared is listed with an empty marks object and an `owners` note until they do. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

moments.label: the transformation's gather (all versions)
moments.note: the aura is pulled in to the sigil and the sound drops away (moveset-rules 10.8): no scream, no flame

moments.label: the transformation's break

marks.4: one ring leaves the body and the ground cracks if he is on it (moveset-rules 10.8); VFX to confirm it is a ring of light and a crack, not rising rubble

moments.note: the flash is in his own colour, never gold, white or red; no shriek

moments.label: a tier-up power-up burst on the ground

marks.4: a power-up at ground level craters the terrain (a crater, dust)

moments.note: VFX to declare the burst's own marks (a flash colour, an aura shape)

moments.label: a signature's charge
moments.note: the aura is a thin outline or rings in the fighter's lane colour, only while charging (Legal's aura constraint); no scream, no shouted name drawn out

moments.label: the world reacts to a tier 3 or 4 fighter (feature 12)

marks.4: rubble lifts gently with weight, cracks spread under a standing fighter, the sky pales or parts

moments.note: never together with a crouch, a scream and a body aura (Legal)

moments.label: the last stand (feature 23, pending Orb's pick)
moments.note: no glowing-blood look, no speech with a body aura, no lightning (Legal)
